newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold eases in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold eases in heavy trade.

text.p: Traded volume on the Istanbul gold exchange jumped to 2,528 kg on Tuesday from Monday's 2,002 kg as banks engaged heavily in arbitrage, dealers said.
Spot gold closed easier at $323.40 an ounce and 1,713,000 per gram, compared to $325.20 and 1,718,500 lira previously, following weaker levels on European markets.
The Turkish currency weakened against the dollar to 164,700 lira, versus the previous 163,850, slowing gold's fall in lira terms.
Most of the day's trade -- 2,034 kg -- was conducted in the morning session due to lower prices. Prices brushed highs of $327 and 1,726,600 lira in the afternoon, which dampened activity.
Some 59.7 percent of total trade was in lira terms.
There was no trade on the exchange's gold futures market for the second day in a row. The market was launched on Friday.
